title: Food Bank No-Show Risk by Slot
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:shift slot_name=* no_show=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(no_show="yes",1,0))) as matched by slot_name
| eval a_no_show_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_no_show_pct
description: Measures the percentage of scheduled shifts that end with a no-show by shift slot.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which shift slot are helping or hurting scheduled shifts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a no-show` on `community:shift` events and summarize the hit rate by `slot_name`.
visualization: Table of shift slot with percentage of scheduled shifts ending with a no-show.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often a no-show happens for each shift slot so you can see where scheduled shifts go smoothly or get stuck.
